title: Shared boundary joints and region hierarchy
plainLanguage: The elbow belongs to both the upper arm and forearm, but it is still one elbow. Regions are ways to focus work, not separate skeletons.
purpose: Allow isolated limb/torso passes without creating conflicting copies of joints.

rules.statement: Region groups reference the same joint IDs; they never duplicate boundary joints.
A correction to a shared joint must be visible to every group that uses that joint.
Verification should stay scoped to the selected region and frame range so unrelated anatomy can remain draft.

implementation.currentSupport: Region hierarchy and scoped verification already behave this way.
implementation.futureWork: Reuse the same region IDs in poser-part and compatibility records.
